title: Khaos Origin
description: An Origin allowing you to play as the primordial god Khaos.
body:
# Khaos

The primordial force through which all things were born.

### 🐔Wabbajack*

Manifest randomness.

Effect list below.

### 🚫 Banish
Banish creatures around you to a separate plane.

Sneak to affect yourself.

### 🌈 Hyperpigmented
Jumping changes your color, and you are slightly transparent.

### ⚖️ Indifference
You can't wear armor, but take 77% reduced damage.

On using a bed, there is a 22% chance the world is set to day.

You swim 1% faster.

### 🎲 Reroll*
You are immune to fire, suffocation, or plant damage.

This randomizes when you sleep.

### 📍 Uncontrol*
Damaging you may grant positive effects to your attackers.

### 🧿 Entropic Progenator*
Blocks may duplicate, or vanish, if you break them barehanded.

Punching a creature adds velocity in a random direction.

### 💧 Reality is Fluid
You can see everything, when in water or lava.


*ability has extra effects in v2


## Ability Evolution (v2)
Unlocked through (secret) advancements

### 🐢 Entropic Progenator: Genesis Blocks
<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>
  Advancement: Hidden in the Depths
  
  Removes barehanded requirement for increased break speed.

  Increased odds for blocks to drop.
</details>

### 🌬️ Reroll: Weighted Perspective


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Advancement: Great View From Up Here

Falling damage added. Roll odds changed to

40%/30%/20%/10% fall/fire/suffocation/plant.

</details>



### 🧬 Uncontrol: Nhilistic Geneticism


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Advancement: Zombie Doctor

When hit, 13% chance to trigger Uncontrol on yourself for double duration.

</details>



### ⛰️ Wabbajack: Stone Soup


<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

Advancement: A Furious Cocktail

Recharge cooldown halved, and charges refresh three at a time. 

</details>

# Wabbajack Effect List

## v1:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

1. Run /time set night.
2. Set everything within 32 blocks to "breed" mode.
3. Teleport all entites within 16 blocks to 8 blocks around your current position.
4. Hero of the village (2 minutes).
5. Bad omen (20 seconds).
6. Summon a witch.
7. Summon a creeper.
8. Summon a wandering trader.
9. Send the player in a random direction right/left.
10. Apply glowing to loaded entities.
11. Apply absorption to loaded entities.
12. Spawn a large levitation cloud.
13. Give the player momentary darkness, with a long jump boost/speed effect.
14. Rotate blocks with the ability to be rotated (barrels, beds, etc).
15. Fire a ray that explodes if it hits an entity.
16. Give the player 16 golden carrots.
17. Teleport the player to where they are looking.
18. Summon a painting.
19. Throw all creatures around you into the air and give them slow falling.
20. Cleanse all effects from all entities within a 16 blocks.
21. Summons four chickens in the air around you.

</details>

## v2:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

22. Says frog in chat.
23. Summons every color sheep.
24. Changes the weather to sun or rain or thunder.
25. Causes a grid of arrows to spawn directly above you.
26. Summons every type of tropical fish in an area around you.
27. Drops a stick with incredible knockback.
28. Spawns an immortal Iron Golem.
29. Drops an unbreakable golden shovel.
30. Spawns a glowing cat.
31. Summons many rabbits around you.
32. Plays either Pigstep or Otherside to players within 10 chunks.
33. Summons two sheep and a pair of name tags.
34. Gives you hundreds of obsidian blocks.
35. Spawns a chicken that occasionally types insults in chat.

</details>


# Notes
---------
Tested on v1.20.1
---------

### Banish
Tp to nether roof

Because of mechanics, if over an OCEAN, you CAN'T TELEPORT back

(runs execute in minecraft:overworld run spreadplayers ~ ~ 0 1 false @s)

### Indifference
About prot IV diamond.

Elytra can be worn.

4m cooldown triggered on using a bed, even if sleep did not occur.

Can trigger during the day.

### Uncontrol
Strength, speed, invisibility, or resistance. 20% chance, 5s buff, 2s cooldown.

### Reroll
Plant damage is berry bushes/cactus.

Suffocation includes drowning, you will still drown, but it will do no damage.
